title: Linear transcript acceptance rule
statement: Given a seed and three possibly missing Boolean transcript values, accept according to the seed type. For a Boolean seed, accept exactly when the first value is present and equals that Boolean. For a seed $(i,	ext{false})$, accept exactly when all three values are present and the third is the Boolean product of the first two. For a seed $(i,	ext{true})$, accept exactly when all three are present and, after interpreting them in the field with two elements, the first plus the second equals the third.
hypotheses_covered: Seed is from the linear check seed space
Transcript has three possibly absent Boolean values
